$comment: English texts of data/cards.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the System Deck, the Games Parlour's card game: its lines, types, heroes' skills, Szczęsny's tiers and words. Each key of the texts keeps the Polish number of variants, as the game picks one by index.
name: System Deck

warrior.name: Charge
warrior.text: A card of yours you choose hits {power}% harder this round.

archer.name: True Shot
archer.text: A card of yours you choose hits the rival's card you point at this round, instead of the one opposite.

mage.name: Transmutation
mage.text: A card of yours you choose changes its type for the rest of the match.
mage.plus: This round it also hits {power}% harder.

cleric.name: Resurrection
cleric.text: If a card of yours you choose falls this round, it comes back with {power}% of its Life.

shadow.name: Switch
shadow.text: After the rival has set up, you swap one card on a line for a card from your reserve.
shadow.plus: The new card hits {power}% harder this round.

warmup.name: Warm-up
warmup.text: Szczęsny plays at half throttle: common and rare cards from the first lands, a few at level 2.

parlour.name: A Game at the Table
parlour.text: Rare and unique cards at levels 2 and 3. Szczęsny picks his cards against yours.

serious.name: A Serious Game
serious.text: Unique and epic creatures at levels 2 and 3. A deck better than the starter will come in handy.

masters.name: The Masters' Table
masters.text: Epic cards and elites at levels 3 and 4. Every mistake costs here.

host.name: Szczęsny's Deck
host.text: His own deck: champions and elites at levels 4 and 5. Few rise from this table with a full purse.

texts.intro: Szczęsny shuffles a deck of cards with creatures of the Bestiary. "Twelve cards, three lines, as in a real battle. Build your deck and take a seat."
texts.starterOffer: "For a good start I'll give you a deck: twelve cards, four of each type. The rest you'll win on your explorations."
texts.starterTaken: Szczęsny slides a deck of twelve cards across the table. "Yours. Play it boldly."
rules: A deck is 12 cards. Each card is a creature of the Bestiary with Attack, Life and a type: Strength, Dexterity or Magic. Strength beats Dexterity, Dexterity beats Magic and Magic beats Strength: a card deals half again as much to a card of the type it beats.

The table has three lines, as in a formation: front, middle and back. Each round Szczęsny first puts cards on his empty lines. Then you put cards from your reserve (4 cards drawn from your deck) on your empty lines. A card stays on its line until it is beaten.
After "Fight" every card hits the card opposite, all at once. With no card opposite, it hits the rival's first card from the front. A card left with no Life is beaten.
Whoever beats all of the rival's cards wins. After 20 rounds the one with more cards left wins, then the one with more Life. If they are equal, it is a draw.
The hero card is your class's skill, once a match. Your class's evolution strengthens it.

A match for a stake: win and you take twice the stake, a draw gives the stake back. You play for a stake at most 10 times a day. The first win of the day at each tier also gives the day's reward, and the first win over a tier a rare card. Training is without a stake and without rewards.
New cards are rarely left by creatures you beat on explorations, more often by elites and champions. The same card won again raises its level, up to level 5: each level means more Attack and Life.
win: "A good match! I didn't see that coming."
"Your win. The cards like you today."
"Well played! Next time I won't hold back."
loss: "My match. The deck forgives no mistakes."
"This time the stake stays with me."
"That was close. Shuffle and come back."
draw: "Even as on a scale. One more match?"
drop: Among the loot lies a card: {card}.
The beaten creature leaves a card: {card}.
texts.firstWin: For your first win over the tier "{tier}" Szczęsny gives you a card: {card}.
